sourceRole: Image2 icon-language source sheet for the route-switch overlay
promptSummary: A no-text bitmap source sheet of isolated Human Protocol sci-fi route-switch icon badges: archive-router title emblem, door, terminal, robot, gate, authorized key, locked key, footer branching mark, and denied key mark. Pure black crop-friendly background, high-end hard-surface UI pixels, cyan/amber facility palette, no Chinese text, no English text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.
notes: The build script keys only edge-connected black background to alpha so internal dark metal faces remain solid.
Runtime uses these cut Image2 badges to replace visible explanatory text in the route-switch overlay.
Accessibility labels remain in React as hidden text and aria labels; no visible UI explanation text is baked into the atlas.
